KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

·       Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million

·       Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics

·       Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases

·       Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements

·       Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level

·       Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments

·       Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance

·       Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

·       Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option

·       Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate

·       The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently

·       The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers

·       The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages

·       The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications

·       A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

·       A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development

·       A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group

·       Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation

·       Good opportunities for both professional and personal development

·       Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance

·       A good canteen scheme and active staff association

·       An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

jobs.occupation: Mechanic, HGV Mechanic or Welder wanted for varied role in Glostrup
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced mechanic or welder who thrives in a varied working environment with a high degree of responsibility? Would you like to work in a small, dynamic team where there is a short path from idea to action? Then you may be the person we are looking for at our workshop in Glostrup.

We are looking for a highly skilled professional with solid experience – preferably someone at senior level – who is able to work independently and take responsibility for both planned maintenance and urgent repairs.

About the Position

You will become part of a dedicated and informal team where collaboration and flexibility are key. We offer a varied working day with a high degree of freedom and responsibility, giving you the opportunity to influence and shape your own tasks.

Our fleet is broad and diverse, meaning you will work with many different types of vehicles and equipment. These include refuse collection vehicles, flatbed and hook-lift trucks, crane trucks, construction trailers, construction machinery and other equipment at our site.

Your tasks will range from troubleshooting and repairs to ongoing maintenance and optimisation. No two days are the same, so it is important that you have a practical approach and enjoy finding solutions to both minor and complex challenges. There may occasionally be overtime, particularly when urgent issues arise and need to be resolved quickly.

Your Qualifications

We imagine that you:

• 
Are a qualified welder, mechanic or HGV mechanic

• 
Have several years of experience from a similar position

• 
Ideally have experience maintaining refuse collection vehicles (not a requirement)

• 
Hold a category B and C driving licence, and preferably CE

• 
Have knowledge of hydraulic and electrical systems

• 
Work in a structured and independent manner

• 
Are reliable, flexible and responsible

• 
Take pride in delivering high-quality work and getting the job done properly the first time

What We Offer

We offer an exciting and varied position in an informal working environment with good colleagues and a friendly atmosphere. You will have opportunities for professional development and the freedom to influence your own working day.

We provide good employment conditions, excellent facilities and a workplace where your contribution is valued. Working hours will be arranged by agreement between Monday and Friday, within the hours of 6:00 am and 6:00 pm.

The position is available as soon as possible, but we are happy to wait for the right candidate.

 Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Dan Andersen on +45 28 45 80 35.

jobs.occupation: Kok søges til restaurant i Blokhus! / We are looking for a chef to join our team at Restaurant Futten & Restaurant Salino in Blokhus!
jobs.description:
ENGLISH BELOW ↓ Vi søger nu en kok til vores team på Restaurant Futten & Restaurant Salino i Blokhus!

Hos os arbejder vi med flere forskellige typer service, så du kommer både til at arbejde med à la carte, buffet og selskaber. Det betyder også, at hverdagen varierer - og at der er mulighed for at udvikle sig inden for flere områder af køkkenfaget.

Restauranterne ligger i den sæsonpræget ferieby Blokhus, hvilket betyder at vi har rigtig travlt i sommerperioden og omkring årets øvrige ferier. Resten af året er tempoet mere roligt, men der er stadig godt med aktivitet og nok at tage fat på da vi har åbent 365 dage om året.

|

Vi leder efter dig, som:

- Har erfaring med at arbejde i køkken, eller som er villig til at lære det

- Kan arbejde selvstændigt samt i et team, og bevare overblikket når der er travlt

- Har lyst til at tage ansvar og være med til at få køkkenet til at fungere

- Trives med en hverdag, hvor opgaverne varierer

- Er en god kollega og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø

- Har lyst til at udvikle dig og måske på sigt tage mere ansvar i køkkenet

|

Vi tilbyder:

- Fastansættelse på fuld tid

- Mulighed for ansvar og udvikling

- En varieret hverdag med både à la carte, buffet og selskaber

- Et køkken med plads til at tage initiativ og komme med idéer

- Et arbejdsliv med både travle perioder og mere rolige perioder

- Relevant sparring samt indflydelse på egen arbejdsdag

- Fleksibel vagtplanlægning

|

Vi forventer ikke at du kan alt fra dag 1, da du får grundig oplæring i forbindelse med opstart. Det vigtigste er at du har lyst til at lære, tager ansvar og har lyst til at være en del af holdet.

Opstart er som udgangspunkt i december, men vi er åbne for eventuel tidligere opstart.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

_________________________________

We are looking for a chef to join our team at Restaurant Futten & Restaurant Salino in Blokhus!

We work with several different types of service including à la carte, buffet and events, meaning that you'll have plenty of opportunities to develop your skills across different areas.

We're located in Blokhus - a popular holiday town at the west coast of Denmark. We're open 365 days a year, but we're particularly busy during the summer and around school holidays - but there's plenty to do in all seasons.

|

We are looking for someone who:

- Have experience in similar positions, or is willing to learn about working in a kitchen

- Can work independently as well as part of a team, while keeping calm and focused during busy hours

- Enjoys a varied working day with different types of tasks

- Is a good colleague and contributes to a positive working environment

- Is motivated to develop their skills and potentially take more responsibility over time

|

We offer:

- A permanent, full-time position

- Opportunities for responsibility

- The opportunity for personal as well as professional development

- A varied working environment with à la carte, buffet and private events

- The possibility to contribute with your own ideas

- Flexible shift schedule

|

We don't expect you to know everything from day one, since you'll receive an introduction and training to help you settle into the role. What matters most is that you're willing to learn, are willing to take responsibility, and want to be part of the team.

The position is expected to start in December, but we are open to an earlier start.

We're looking forward to hearing from you!

Ready to be part of our crew?

At Comfort Hotel Vesterbro, we keep things real, urban, and uncomplicated. We give our guests what they need and skip the fluff, creating a space where locals, travelers, startups, and globetrotters all feel at home. We’re looking for a breakfast team member who gets our vibe - someone who knows how to make guests feel welcomed, energized, and inspired in the morning. Comfort Hotel  has taken the undisputed position as the Nordic region's leading budget hotel chain.

What you’ll be doing:

• Welcome guests with a friendly, no-nonsense approach, setting the tone for a great day

• Prepare and cook breakfast according to the Comfort Breakfast Manual and food safety guidelines

• Keep the breakfast room clean and tidy, buzzing with energy and positivity, working closely with colleagues to maintain Comfort’s effortless, urban vibe

• Refill breakfast during opening hours and taking care of dishes both during and after service hours

• Always following the Comfort rules and keeping our guest promise

• Work hours will be according to schedule with shifts between 05.30-15.00 and will include weekends and holidays.

Is this you?

• You’re upbeat, approachable, and thrive in a fast-paced, urban environment

• You’re excited to be part of a diverse team, with colleagues from several backgrounds

• You’re a morning person who gladly swaps the morning rush hour commute for the freedom of afternoons and evenings for personal interests. Your work shift will start from 5:30.

• Quick on your feet, you adapt to whatever the day throws your way - with a smile

• Experience in hospitality or customer service is a bonus, but your personality and drive are what really count

As a breakfast crew member at Comfort Hotel, it is a plus to be proficient in English. Additional language skills may be beneficial to your application.

That little extra we offer our employees at Strawberry

We believe in making things easy - not just for our guests, but for our team too. Here’s what you’ll get:

• A fast-paced, energetic work environment that values your individuality

• Opportunities to grow and make your mark within the Strawberry group

• Staff discounts and friends & family rates at our 200+ hotels

• Four free hotel nights each year based on contract

• A 25% discount on food & beverages at our restaurants and bars

• Sweet deals on experiences, travel, retail, and more.

• Access to a digital training and development tool with some mandatory and LOTS of other courses

About Strawberry

Strawberry is not your typical hotel company. With over 240 hotels, 120 restaurants, and 20 spas, we create thousands of experiences every day. Built on our core values - energy, courage, and enthusiasm - our team of 20,000 employees from 166 countries keeps us moving forward.

Perfect match much?

Apply now and be part of a team that makes every stay easy, urban, and unforgettable. We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so don’t wait - positions may be filled before the deadline. This is a permanent position with a start date to be agreed upon.

We’re Comfort Hotel® – a hotel chain that promises to give our guests what they need, and skip the unnecessary. We have great locations, urban design and we’re offering selected services, but the service we give is great. We aim to be Easy on the wallet, have Easy access, be Easy to enjoy and last but definitely not least – be Easy on the planet.

Comfort Hotel® is part of Strawberry.

Admiral Hotel is looking for a Souschef who is ready to step forward as a leader and front figure in the kitchen. You value classical craftsmanship, thrive on creating structure, and enjoy taking responsibility—not only for the food but also for the team behind it. As Souschef at aye aye, you’ll be the driving force in the daily kitchen operations, setting the standard for quality, precision, and teamwork.

aye aye – part of Admiral Hotel

aye aye is Admiral Hotel’s restaurant – a modern interpretation of classic gastronomy with a focus on flavor, precision, and craftsmanship. We combine the intense flavors of the Mediterranean with Nordic simplicity, working with pure ingredients that are transformed into simple yet delicious dishes.

Meet the team behind aye aye here: https://restaurantayeaye.dk/team

Who you are

As our new Souschef, you will become a key part of a well-established kitchen management team. You will report directly to the Head Chef and have significant influence on our menus, work structures, and the daily working environment.

You will work across the entire culinary operation – from our restaurant aye aye and the terrace to room service and large banquets.

You’ll be a great fit if you:

• 
Are a trained chef with at least 5 years of experience in a similar role.

• 
Are structured and quick to act in situations that require immediate solutions. In other words—you can plan, stay organized, and ensure the kitchen is always ready for service.

• 
Have strong communication skills, ensuring handovers, orders, and teamwork are always clear and precise.

• 
Understand and agree that a good working environment is the foundation for great food.

• 
Take professional pride in your work—you care about quality, craftsmanship, and attention to detail in every dish.

• 
Master classical techniques and are confident with sauces, stocks, pasta, fish and meat butchery, bread baking, as well as ice cream and dessert preparation.

What we offer

• 
Full-time position with a fixed schedule (normally with every other weekend off)

• 
Fair working conditions under a collective agreement.

• 
A team of food enthusiasts who love their craft.

• 
A workplace with a strong sense of community. There’s room for laughter and plenty of opportunities to be social with colleagues through our many staff events.

• 
Great employee discounts and 4 annual stays at Strawberry hotels across the Nordics.

Do you see a match?

If this sounds like something for you, don't hesitate to send us an application.

Admiral is situated in the heart of Copenhagen, where the sea meets the city, and where Copenhagen meets the world. Housed in a historic 18th-century warehouse along the scenic harbor, Admiral blends modern elegance with rich history creating authentic warmth. At Admiral, we strive for ambitious excellence in everything we do – from the smallest details to the most memorable guest experiences and with a culture rooted in attentive hospitality, we create a sense of home, where every interaction is infused with genuine care and a passion for service.

Admiral is more than a place to stay in Copenhagen. It’s a place to be.

TIPSTER is looking for a Partnerships & Events Manager to shape, secure, and deliver the drops, pop-ups, and events we bring to hundreds of thousands of community members. Working closely with our leadership and operations team, you’ll build lasting relationships with hospitality partners, negotiate collaborations, and take an active role in bringing them to life.

TIPSTER is on a mission to change how people discover food and drink. Our drops are curated, limited-time offers that connect our community with exceptional food-and-beverage concepts. Alongside collaborations with names such as Gasoline Grill, Ceres, and Atelier September, we create events and pop-ups around the world, including our BAKERY RUN series.

This is a hands-on role for someone with experience in hospitality and sales who is as comfortable closing a sale as they are helping run an event. You’ll have a direct influence on who we work with and what our community gets to experience, with your focus shifting between sales and events throughout the year.

YOU WILL

• Identify and approach restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and other hospitality concepts for drops.

• Develop and pitch drop concepts, negotiate terms, and secure agreements with partners.

• Build and maintain long-term partner relationships, developing opportunities for repeat collaborations.

• Help develop new event and pop-up concepts and research potential venues and partners.

• Coordinate with venues, partners, and suppliers to keep plans, timelines, and practical details on track.

• Take part in the hands-on execution of events and pop-ups, from preparation and setup to on-site operations and follow-up.

All work will take place at our office in Frederiksberg.

WHO YOU ARE

• Experienced in sales, with 2-4 years of relevant professional experience and a background in the restaurant or food-and-beverage industry (e.g., you have a wine sales rep background or similar).

• Outgoing and confident in approaching new partners, with a strong instinct for building lasting relationships.

• Genuinely interested in restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and the people behind them.

• Commercially minded and comfortable pitching ideas, negotiating terms, and closing deals.

• Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage several collaborations at different stages.

• Proactive and dependable, taking ownership of tasks and following them through to completion.

• Comfortable balancing relationship building and sales with practical, hands-on event work.

• Adaptable when priorities shift and eager to develop your skills in partnerships and events.

WHAT TIPSTER OFFERS

• A direct role in shaping how our community discovers great places around the world through drops, events, and pop-ups.

• A place on a team challenging how people discover and experience food and drink.

• Responsibility and opportunities to grow from day one.

• The opportunity to build long-term relationships with some of the world’s best restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and food-and-beverage concepts.

• A varied working day that combines commercial responsibility, creative development, and hands-on execution.

• An informal, collaborative workplace with a small, globally active team.

HOW TO APPLY

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Emma Trøst, Head of Operations, at emma@tipster.io or Julie Schacht, Event & Operations Manager, at julie@tipster.io.

If TIPSTER’s mission aligns with your ambitions, send your cover letter, CV, and any relevant supporting documents to career@tipster.io.

We are looking to fill the position as soon as possible, but we are willing to wait for the right candidate.

Are you up for a challenge?

We are looking for a senior project manager with commercial understanding and technical flair. Ideally with experience from international projects touching upon both civil works and production systems (Mech/Elec/Aut) as we participate in both greenfield and brownfield projects around the world.

The Company

Frontmatec is recognized for developing and delivering high-quality systems across the entire meat industry value chain - ranging from carcass classification, slaughtering lines, and cutting and deboning lines, to hygiene solutions, control systems, logistics, and packaging. Frontmatec's value propositions center on providing equipment that enhances competitiveness by increasing yield, improving raw material utilization, raising hygiene standards, and reducing dependence on labor resources. As a result, the company's customers typically are high-volume slaughterhouses, where optimization leads to significant efficiency gains.

In 2022, Frontmatec Group was acquired by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. (in the following referred to as KKR), a leading American investment firm with a portfolio of over 700 companies worldwide. Following the acquisition, KKR established Fortifi, a dedicated FoodTech division focused on acquiring and developing companies within the industry. Fortifi brings together innovative businesses to drive technological advancements and operational excellence across the food sector. Within Fortifi, Frontmatec is the largest player, contributing significantly to the group's expertise and market presence. There is a total of 3,000+ employees across Fortifi. Frontmatec serves as the key driver of innovation and growth within this expanding portfolio.

Your Future Role

The role of a Senior Project Manager is to lead complex and business-critical customer projects, ensure successful delivery, and contribute to the continuous development of project execution, customer relationships, and organizational capabilities.

Primary Responsibilities

· Lead and manage complex or high-impact customer projects end-to-end

· Ensure delivery on time, within budget, and in line with quality standards

· Act as primary point of contact and build strong customer relationships

· Lead cross-functional project teams and ensure high performance

· Drive planning, scheduling, and financial tracking with transparency

· Proactively manage risks, opportunities, and margin development

· Coordinate execution phases including implementation and delivery

· Act as escalation point for stakeholders

· Ensure alignment between commercial, technical, and operational aspects

· Drive lessons learned and continuous improvement

Accountabilities

· Overall responsibility for project performance and customer satisfaction

· Leadership of cross-functional teams and delivery excellence

· Financial performance including budget control and forecasting

· Application of project governance and best practices

· Team performance and collaboration

· Improvement of execution efficiency

About you

To be successful in this role you need to have:

- Good stakeholder management skills

- Financial and technical understanding

- Fluency in minimum Danish and English languages

- Ability to travel internationally (30-45 days / year)

- Experience with larger projects +10 mil USD

- Persistence and an eye to critical details

Ideally you also have:

- One or more project management certifications

- Experience from the food industry/ meat industry

- Experience working in AX 2012

What is in it for you

We welcome you to a messy environment where we are currently streamlining and cleaning up. The salary is only decent given the occasional hectic environment and ad hoc challenges that can occur in our projects. However, the team is great and the company is full of good and helpful colleagues. Furthermore, you will have a stake in our company as you will become an owner cf. Fortify's Ownership Programme.

**TDC NET is going through one of the largest transformation and modernization phases in its long history. This is an opportunity to revamp and shape TDC NET's vast estate from the ground up as TDC positions itself to become a leading technology provider.

As Workforce Enablement Tech Lead, you will own the technical direction, standards, and evolution of TDC NET’s digital workplace services. You will be accountable for shaping and continuously improving endpoint and desktop across physical devices and virtual environments. Acting as the bridge between infrastructure leadership and engineering teams, you will translate strategic direction into robust, scalable, and user-centric technical solutions.

• Own and continuously improve Workforce Enablement services aligned with enterprise infrastructure and digital workplace strategy.

• Define technical strategy, architecture, and standards across endpoints and desktops.

"As Workforce Enablement Tech Lead, you will own the technical direction, standards, and evolution of TDC NET’s digital workplace services, and your insights will be critical to TDC NET’s safe and compliant infrastructure operations” says Qasam Ahmed, Head of IT Core Services

About you

You are motivated by transformation and change, and this you combine with:

Core Skills

• Extensive experience in endpoint management and automation using Microsoft Intune and PowerShell

• Hands-on expertise with VDI platforms such as Citrix, VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, and KASM

• Understanding of endpoint security and compliance, including Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender, and Zero Trust

• Experience with Windows and Linux desktop environments in enterprise setups

• Experience leading technical engineers and working with cross-functional IT teams

Contact:

Company Description

Are you curious about modern software development and looking for your next challenge? At Deloitte Engineering, we are seeking motivated part-time student helpers who want to take an active role in improving their technical and problem-solving competencies while growing our Engineering practice.

With more than 2.700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Consulting.

About the team

We, the Engineering offering of Deloitte Technology & Transformation Denmark, are on the lookout for additional team-players for our quickly growing practice of software engineers, cloud consultants, and IT management consultants. We assist our clients, some of the largest companies, agencies, and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics, on the implementation of new cloud-native systems as part of their digital transformation – and we need you to help build their opportunities and meet their challenges!

Together, we will accelerate your career towards becoming a proficient software engineer and enable a smooth transition to a potential full-time position after your studies. At Deloitte, we are committed to empowering you throughout your career development. As a new employee, you are assigned a talent manager to support your career aspirations and development. You will also be part of a tech community with monthly meetings in which we share knowledge, investigate new topics, and upskill within relevant technologies and methodologies.

Job Description

As a student worker at the Engineering offering, you will be supporting experienced developers on many different projects. To thrive in our team, you embrace working with varying tech-stacks and different aspects of development. Our client assignments can vary greatly, but common for all of them are that we strive to work with the technologies that the client prefers. Regardless of the technology, we provide you with the opportunity and tools needed to learn and grow within all of them.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Developing applications and solutions of all sizes, frequently in Agile settings (SAFE/Scrum). This includes both backend and frontend development, often directed towards public clouds or on-premises.

• Enabling DevOps through development of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code.

• Building internal capabilities through community tasks, maybe within new business areas.

• Joining in on workshops and sales pitches and contributing to proposals for new client projects.

Qualifications

You are a Master's student at the top of your class, preferably within Computer Science, Engineering, or similar with at least one year of studies left and the energy to work 15-20 hours per week with us. Furthermore, you are either a native Danish speaker or highly proficient in written and spoken Danish.

What you bring to the team:

• Programming-wise, you have experience with either Java, C#/.Net, Python, C, C++, GO, Clojure or JavaScript/TypeScript.

• You have strong analytical skills and a focus on quality and detail.

• You are a positive-minded teammate with the ability to work and solve problems in a structured way.

• You can communicate and express yourself clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What we can offer you

We highly appreciate the knowledge, experience, and perspectives our consultants bring, and in exchange, we make sure they develop professionally, meet their career goals, and enjoy their time with Deloitte. Therefore, other than an incredible social calendar, we offer our consultants:

• Enrolment in the Consultant Academy, which is our training program for building the essential Consultant skills. The Academy takes you to exciting locations to learn from leading professionals in their respective fields.

• Focused career development by assigning you a talent manager who acts as your mentor and guides you in your professional journey in Deloitte.

• The opportunity to participate in projects and internal work with our different market offerings to find the right fit for you.

On the social aspect, Deloitte Technology & Transformation is second to none. We offer everything from various sports communities to festivals – not to mention the yearly Trip where all our colleagues come together off-site to create lasting memories. Additionally, we have a strong sense of belonging and community in Engineering, and we support each other every day to make an impact with our clients and to promote personal and professional development.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Send your application, CV, and other relevant documents before the 1st of November, 2026. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: Before or 1st of January, 2027

Please do not hesitate to contact Sophus Benee Olsen at soolsen@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Do you want to work on some of the most complex bridge, immersed tunnels and underground structures in Denmark and internationally? Are you motivated by structural engineering, advanced analysis and developing innovative solutions? Do you want to be a part of an international frontrunner in major structures? Then this could be your next opportunity at COWI.

At COWI, we are seeking a Junior Structural Engineer to support our team on major infrastructure projects. You will join a highly skilled group of engineers delivering solutions for bridges, immersed tunnels, underground structures and other complex civil engineering projects. Working alongside experienced specialists, you will contribute to projects that improve how people and societies connect.

Turn challenges into sustainable solutions

As a Junior Structural Engineer, you will contribute to the design and analysis of complex infrastructure projects from early concept development through detailed design and construction support. You will work closely with colleagues across disciplines and geographies, gaining practical experience and developing your technical skills and engineering judgement.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Performing structural analysis and design of civil engineering structures

• Working with FEM and structural analysis tools

• Preparing calculations, technical documentation and design deliverables

• Collaborating with structural, geotechnical, BIM and other engineering disciplines

• Contributing to digital engineering initiatives, including automated workflows and parametric design solutions

• Participating in technical discussions, reviews and knowledge-sharing activities within the team and structural engineering community

Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

We are looking for a motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and is eager to develop within a collaborative and international environment. You combine a strong interest in structural engineering with curiosity about new technologies, digital tools, and innovative ways of solving engineering problems. Knowledge of design of bridges, tunnels, underground structures or other complex concrete structures will be highly relevant.

On top of that you have:

• A Master degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline

• 0-5 years of professional experience in structural or civil engineering.

• Knowledge with finite element modelling (FEM) and structural analysis

• Knowledge of concrete design principles and relevant design standards such as for instance Eurocode 2

• Interest or experience in automated workflows and parametric design tools, such as Grasshopper

• Interest or experience in AI, programming or engineering automation is an advantage

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to organise own work while contributing actively to a team

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility, and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide for our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America, and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy, and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist Shruti Gupta at srgu@cowi.com, or Head of Discipline Major Structures, Konrad Bienko, at kobi@cowi.com. Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV - no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Why join COWI?

• Work on complex Bridge, Tunnel and Underground structures that push the boundaries of engineering, technology and sustainability.

• Get the opportunity to contribute to major international projects with global impact.

• Access international Master Classes and learning opportunities to support your professional development.

• Join a strong international network of 30+ countries, sharing knowledge and expertise across borders.

• Work in an office in collaborate with 100+ highly skilled colleagues from the Major Structures unit. The office is located in Kgs. Lyngby, Denmark.

• Become part of the COWI community through clubs, events and professional networks.

• Enjoy a strong social culture with activities such as Friday bars, Summer Parties and Christmas lunches.

We are looking for a proactive People & Organization (P&O) Generalist to join our People Experience team. You will support employees and leaders with day-to-day HR, while helping us improve the processes and enable value adding HR.

You will be a part of a global team, where you will be the key responsible for a variety of tasks and services related to the employee lifecycle for our Danish organization. It is a varied role that requires ownership for details as well as being mindful of the broader picture. Ideally, you will combine hands-on HR operations with problem-solving and continuous improvement in an international environment.

Become Part Of a Collaborative People Experience Team

**You will join a collaborative team of 13 talented colleagues within our global People & Organization function. Working mainly with our Danish organization, you will partner closely with employees, leaders, Talent Acquisition, P&O Legal, Payroll, and colleagues across the business.

The role is based at our headquarters in Hellerup, Greater Copenhagen, and reports to the Head of People Experience.

Your focus will be to make HR support clear, efficient, and compliant while contributing ideas that make our ways of working simpler and better.

**Your Responsibilities

**You will support the everyday moments that shape the employee experience - from joining Bavarian Nordic to changes during employment and eventually leaving the company.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Support onboarding (contract and systems), employment changes, leave administration, and offboarding

• 
Guide employees and leaders on HR policies, processes, benefits, and employment matters

• 
Maintain accurate, compliant employee data and transactions in our core HCM system, Workday

• 
Handle leave administration, such as parental leave

• 
Drive global mobility activities, including work permits and services from external mobility partners

• 
Collaborate with external HR providers in countries without a local HR presence

• 
Improve processes and contribute to P&O projects that strengthen the employee experience.

**What We Are Looking For

**You bring a solid foundation in HR operations and enjoy balancing detail-oriented administration with improvement work while building excellent relations to employees.

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Holds a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field

• 
Has solid experience in HR operations and employee lifecycle services, typically two years or more, depending on the scope and depth of experience

• 
Ideally brings experience from a regulated or compliance-driven industry on the global scene

• 
Understands HR processes, basic principles of employment law (DK), and maintains a strong compliance mindset

• 
Is comfortable working with HR systems: Workday & Docusign experience is an advantage

• 
Communicates fluently in Danish and English, both verbally and in writing

You will thrive in this role if you enjoy bringing structure, take initiative, and look for continuous improvement. You are energetic and bring a warm, service-minded approach that helps you build strong relationships. At the same time, you confidently take ownership and stand your ground when needed. You take pride in keeping essential day-to-day administrative tasks running smoothly.

If you are excited about combining HR operations, employee support, compliance, and continuous improvement, then this could be the right opportunity for you.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, you will join a purpose-driven company where people make a difference every day. Our work helps protect lives through innovative vaccines. A strong employee experience is an important part of making that possible.

We offer a collaborative and international environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to contribute to creating great employee experiences across the organization.

Beyond this, we offer:

• 
Flexible working conditions, pension scheme, health insurance, competitive compensation package and bonus opportunities

• 
A high-quality canteen with a wide selection and take-away options

• 
Access to fitness discounts, massage scheme, and an active staff club with social and sporting events

**Caught your interest?

**If you are ready to become our next P&O pioneer, please apply now through our designated application platform. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position

Please note that visa sponsorship and relocation assistance are not available for this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

__Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

_Velatir — Odense, Denmark. Full-time, on-site.

_Velatir is the European AI trust layer. We help organisations see how AI is already used across their work, keep ownership of that use, move faster whilst staying compliant with regulations like the EU AI Act, GDPR, and NIS2. We are EU-sovereign by design, and we sell enablement rather than enforcement — we are not the AI police, we are the AI coach.

We are early and moving fast. Focused on revenue and execution,, a fast-growing customer base across the Nordics, France and Benelux, and a Head of Marketing who has just joined to build the function. This is the second hire into the marketing team. One that will be essential for our growth trajectory.

**About The Role

**Your job is qualified pipeline. You own the machine that turns our story into meetings.

This is a hands-on, execution-owning role at the measurable end of the funnel. You would own the channels, the campaigns, the automation, the attribution, and the numbers that come out of them.

Concretely, in your first months you would paid campaigns from an interim external partner, build our first lead magnets and nurture sequences, fix the conversion path on the website, and get attribution to the point where we can say which spend produced which meeting. From there you scale what works and kill what doesn't.

For a while you are - the - demand function. If you want to run a team of specialists on day one, this is not the role. If you want to build the engine yourself and then hire under it, it is.

Our buyers are CISOs, CIOs and compliance leads at mid-market companies of roughly 200–2,000 people, running twenty to a hundred AI tools with limited governance over any of them. Most do not yet know this is a category. Generating demand before the category exists is the hard, interesting part of this job.

What success looks like

By month six, 30-40% of new pipeline is marketing-sourced, cost per lead is falling, and the sales team trusts what arrives in their calendar. You can show leadership, with data, where the pipeline came from. You would have built the engine we scale European expansion on.

How the role fits

This role reports to the Head of Marketing and sits within the commercial organisation. You would work with sales every day and have direct access to the founders. The marketing team grows to four over the coming year, and there is room to grow into leading demand as it does.

**Responsibilities

**

• Own marketing-sourced pipeline and the reporting behind it.

• Build and run demand generation across paid, organic, email, webinars and events.

• Own the marketing stack — HubSpot, CRM integration, lead scoring, automation.

• Own the funnel and attribution end to end, so we know what works and what to stop.

• Take over and scale paid media from our interim external partner.

• Turn Velatir's positioning into campaigns, landing pages and copy that convert.

• Improve website conversion and demo-booking flow.

• Work with sales on lead handover, follow-up and meeting quality.

• Manage demand spend and make the case for where it goes.

• Support entry into new European markets with localised campaigns.

Qualifications

• 4–6 years running demand generation in B2B SaaS, ideally at an early stage.

• You have owned a pipeline number and can talk about what you did when you missed it.

• Deep hands-on skill with marketing automation, CRM and attribution. You build the reporting yourself.

• Real paid media experience — LinkedIn and Google — including managing budget and taking over from an agency.

• You can write copy that converts for a technical or regulated product.

• AI native. You use AI tools daily and build them into how campaigns run. This is a strong requirement — our own AI governance is our best case study.

• Comfortable owning execution end to end, and working within a positioning and narrative framework set by the Head of Marketing.

• Familiarity with selling to mid-market and regulated buyers. Compliance, security or govtech experience is a plus.

• Clear written and verbal communication in English. Danish is helpful.

Practical details

• Location: Odense, Denmark. This is a full on-site role. You would work in person with the team every day.

• Remuneration: competitive salary with stock options. You would share in what the company builds.

**Market Director Health and Public Institutions – Buildings & Industry

**__**Lyngby or Aarhus, Odense or Vejle

**_

_**Do you want to help shape some of Denmark's and the Nordic region's most important healthcare, education and public building projects? Can you build trusted relationships with key clients, grow business opportunities, and lead complex pursuits in a market with significant societal impact? And do you combine solid commercial acumen with deep insight into the health and public institutions sector? Then join COWI as our new Market Director for Health & Public Institutions within Buildings & Industry and apply your knowledge and curiosity to enable a better tomorrow.

**_

_**Shape the future of healthcare and public buildings

**_To strengthen COWI’s customer-centric approach, we are looking for a Market Director to drive business development and coordinate sales efforts within Health & Public Institutions in our Buildings & Industry sector.

This is a key role in one of COWI’s strategic growth markets, covering healthcare, education, research, cultural facilities and public development projects across Denmark and the Nordics. You will help position COWI on major hospital developments, universities, public institutions, refurbishment programmes and other complex projects that contribute to the development of society.

What makes this role unique is its pure focus on market leadership, where success is defined by customer value, business growth, and a strong market presence. Working closely with specialists, project managers and technical experts, you will build relationships, identify opportunities and grow COWI’s presence in the market. You will also become part of an experienced business development community that shares best practices and drives commercial excellence across COWI.

As part of a team of 25 experienced market professionals across COWI and Arkitema, you will work at the forefront of our business development efforts. Reporting to the Senior Market Director, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to deepen client relationships, unlock strategic opportunities, and lead pursuits from early engagement through to project win, contributing directly to the continued growth of our business.

With increasing investments in healthcare, public buildings and sustainable transformation, the market offers significant growth potential. Your sector insight, commercial mindset and customer understanding will help position COWI as a preferred partner for public clients and healthcare organisations across the Nordic region.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Grow business development and growth across the Health & Public Institutions market segment by identifying, prioritizing, and converting strategic opportunities.

• Build and maintain close relationships with key customers, partners, and decisionmakers, acting as a trusted advisor and Key Account Manager for selected clients.

• Develop and manage a healthy sales pipeline, manage Go/No-Go decisions, and drive capture planning for major pursuits and tenders.

Lead and support complex proposal processes, ensuring compelling value propositions and effective collaboration across disciplines and business units.

• Provide direction and coordination for the Business Development team supporting the market segment, ensuring effective collaboration and delivery of market priorities.

• Monitor market trends, upcoming investments, and customer needs to help shape market strategies and long-term growth initiatives.

• Represent COWI externally through customer meetings, industry networks, conferences, and strategic partnerships.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**Like us, you believe that successful business development is built on trust, collaboration and long-term relationships. You are motivated by creating opportunities, understanding customer needs and bringing together the best teams to deliver value for clients and society. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working closely with fellow Market Directors and multidisciplinary teams to achieve shared goals.

To perform well in this role, it is essential that you bring solid market insight and a well-established network within healthcare, public institutions or the built environment sector. Equally important is your ability to build internal alliances and leverage the collective expertise of the organisation rather than acting alone.

On top of that, you will have:

• A relevant educational background such as engineering, architecture, business or a related discipline.

• Extensive experience in business development, client management, or market leadership within healthcare, public institutions, architecture, construction, or engineering consultancy.

• Deep knowledge of public-sector customers, procurement processes, and market dynamics, combined with a well-established professional network.

• Demonstrated skill in building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and converting opportunities into long-term partnerships.

• Experience contributing to large and complex tenders, proposals, and commercial negotiations.

• Demonstrated ability to provide leadership, direction, and coordination across Business Development teams, account managers, and framework agreement holders, ensuring a shared focus on market growth and client development without formal personnel responsibility.

• Solid communication and stakeholder management skills, with professional proficiency in both Danish and English.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability and strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and collaboration – because that is what brings out the best in you, both at work and at home. With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people bringing expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?

**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Market Director Mikael Voldborg, Buildings & Industry, at mivo@cowi.com, or Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, Janne Nielsen, at jane@cowi.com.

Get to know us better on our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we aim to achieve, and what it is like to be part of COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or cover letter required. Please add a short motivation for the role (4–5 lines) at the top of your CV. When it comes to photos, we prefer to form our first impression face to face rather than from a picture. If relevant, please also attach your portfolio.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI – inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair working environment where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities to thrive and develop. Our leaders act as role models for inclusive leadership and contribute to a culture where diverse perspectives and professional approaches are seen as a strength. We integrate diversity and inclusion into relevant decisions and processes, and when forming teams across architecture and engineering disciplines. We do this because it is part of our values – and simply because it is the right thing to do.

**About The Position

**As a Powerplant Engineer within Sunclass Airlines, you will have a key role within our Technical Department and CAMO organization focusing on either our A321ceo/neo or A330neo fleets. You will be responsible for overseeing and coordinating all engineering activities related to the maintenance, repair, and airworthiness within Powerplant Engineering and be involved in many other areas of the Technical Department as needed.

**Amongst Others, Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Ensuring compliance with all continuous airworthiness requirements associated with EASA Part CAMO within Powerplant Engineering

• Providing Powerplant Engineering advice and support to all the key areas of the airline

• Providing engine shop visit oversight, liaising with the applicable MROs to ensure that the repair and overhaul of engines/APUs comply with regulatory and contractual requirements

• Overseeing fleet reliability, monitoring fleet technical performance, developing improvement plans as required and generating the bi-weekly Engine Health Report.

• Performing Powerplant defect analysis, including monitoring and investigation of repetitive defects

• Assessing and managing technical publications including Service Bulletins, Regulatory Authority information and Airworthiness Directives to maintain and improve the fleet

• Liaising with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and vendors on all associated engineering and contractual / spares provisioning issues

• Involvement in the negotiation of relevant contracts and the subsequent ownership of those contracts

• Out of hours technical support and necessary communication with OEMs to enable the aircraft's safe return to service. (AOG Support)

**Must Haves

****Who we are looking for

**

• Degree in relevant Engineering subject or equivalent industry experience

• Thorough understanding of airworthiness regulations (EASA) and demonstrated experience in compliance management

• Specific experience with either CFM56/LEAP (A321) or Trent 7000 (A330) engine types

• Experience in Supplier and Contract Management

**Preferred

**

• Experience with AMOS or similar Management Information Systems (MIS)

• Experience with aircraft maintenance programmes, reliability and engine condition monitoring

• Experience of successfully managing complex engineering projects relevant to your field of responsibility

• Experience of working to company procedures

• Computer & IT literate

As a person, we are looking for someone with strong communication and interpersonal skills. You have excellent problem-solving abilities and are able to make appropriate and timely decisions. It is also important in this role to be conscientious, efficient, self-motivated and result driven.

**We offer

**We offer an exciting and developing environment where you get the opportunity for an internal career. We have a high level of employee engagement, which is shown year after year in our internal employee survey. We love our job and welcome you on board our journey in the Nordic Leisure Travel Group!

Sunclass Airlines is part of the Nordic Leisure Travel Group (NLTG), which consists of the tour operators Spies in Denmark, Ving and Globetrotter in Sweden, Ving in Norway, Tjäreborg in Finland and the hotel company Resorts & Hotels. Sunclass Airlines flies the majority of the travel group's guests to our charter destinations and has over 1.000.000 travelers per year.

Read more about us at sunclassairlines.dk.

No Relocation Assistance Offered

****Who We Are

****Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

****People Experience Partner Nordics

******Salary Range: 643500 - 715000 annually

******Who We Are

****Colgate-Palmolive Company is a caring, innovative growth company that is reimagining a healthier future for all people, their pets, and our planet. Focused on Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, and Pet Nutrition, we sell our products in more than 200 countries and territories under globally recognized brands. We are celebrated for our leadership in sustainability, community wellbeing, and our unwavering commitment to living our core values.

Global People professionals are consistently drawn to Colgate-Palmolive by the exceptional opportunities for career advancement and a strong alignment with our purpose-driven company Values: We are Caring, We are Inclusive, We are Courageous. Within our Global People function, we foster a culture of high trust and autonomy, ensuring you feel empowered to make impactful decisions and directly influence our broader strategic priorities while you build a fulfilling, long-term career.

As a member of the People Experience team, you will be the heartbeat of the employee journey, owning the local execution of Global People programs and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can perform at their best and reach their full potential. You will be the primary partner for employees and managers in the Nordic Countries translating HR policies into practical solutions and driving operational excellence across the region. This is a unique opportunity for you to gain broad exposure across diverse businesses while influencing the growth and development of our global workforce.

In this role, you will act as a key generalist partner to employees and managers—guiding talent development, supporting organizational initiatives, supporting Employee Relations cases, and managing the employee lifecycle from onboarding through career transitions. Simultaneously, you will take ownership of accurate, compliant, and timely monthly payroll operations across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland, managing relationships with external providers and maintaining rigorous compliance with local labor and tax laws.

****Key Responsibilities

• People Experience Generalist

Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms.

**Welcome to Generation CE

**You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions.

As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations

• translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes

• ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends

• overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives

• strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams

• promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience

• bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team

• understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry

• have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management

• can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions

• communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English.
