jobs.occupation: Defence Business Development Lead, Space Inventor
jobs.description:
Space Inventor is looking for an experienced Defence Business Development Lead to drive business development, collaboration and sales within the defence and security market.

The Defence Business Development Lead will be responsible for identifying, developing and closing opportunities with defence customers, government organisations, procurement agencies, defence primes and strategic industry partners across Europe and internationally, with a focus on European, Nordic and Baltic regions.

The role will focus on satellite missions, constellations and space-based capabilities supporting areas such as ISR, SIGINT, Earth observation, maritime surveillance, situational awareness, secure communications and sovereign space capabilities.

This is a senior hands-on government- and customer-facing role. You will own opportunities from early market engagement and requirement shaping through RFI/RFP, proposal development, negotiation and contract award. As the business development lead, you will be supported by a cross-functional team of specialists that will help shape competitive and technically sound proposals.

A key part of the role is to engage with partners/primes and government officials before formal procurements are released. You will use your existing defence network and market understanding to identify emerging requirements, programmes and partnerships where Space Inventor's satellite capabilities can create operational value.

You do not need to be a satellite engineer, but you must have a solid understanding of the sales cycle and the ability to navigate complex sales processes. Additionally, you must be able to understand complex operational requirements and engage credibly with military, governmental, commercial and technical stakeholders.

The job is located in Aalborg or Copenhagen, Denmark. You’ll report to the Mission Sales Director and work closely with both the marketing and sales teams.

Your Responsibilities

• Lead commercial negotiations covering scope, pricing, contractual conditions and programme requirements.

• Develop and grow Space Inventor's business within the European and international defence and security market, with focus on Nordics and Baltics.

• Identify and develop opportunities through an established network across Ministries of Defence, armed forces, procurement agencies, defence primes, system integrators and strategic partners.

• Engage customers early to understand operational requirements, upcoming programmes and procurement plans before formal tenders are released.

• Own the commercial sales cycle from qualification through RFI/RFQ/RFP, proposal, negotiation and contract award.

• Develop strategic accounts and capture plans for priority defence programmes and customers.

• Identify and qualify local partners in the focus countries and build partnerships/consortia to address local needs and requirements.

• Monitor defence programmes, budgets, tenders, competitors and market developments to identify future opportunities.

• Maintain the defence sales pipeline, forecasts and opportunity strategies and contribute to Space Inventor's overall defence market strategy.

• Represent Space Inventor at customer meetings, exhibitions and industry events.

Qualifications

You should have strong knowledge of the defence sector, its operational environment and customer landscape, combined with a good understanding of space-based defence capabilities and their role in modern defence operations.

You do not need to be a technical space specialist, but you should be able to understand defence requirements, identify where satellite-based solutions can provide operational value and engage credibly with defence customers and Space Inventor's technical specialists.

We expect you to have:

• Significant proven experience within defence sales, business development, capture management, partnership development and complex defence solution sales.

• A successful track record of developing business with defence and governmental customers, including signed contracts and long-term strategic partnerships

• A strong and relevant existing network within the European defence industry, including relationships with defence organisations, procurement agencies, primes, system integrators and strategic partners.

• A strong international outlook and preferably an established global defence network.

• Experience engaging directly with Ministries of Defence, armed forces, defence procurement organisations or other governmental stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of B2G sales and defence procurement processes.

• Ability to understand technically complex products and communicate their operational and commercial value.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Willingness to travel frequently within Europe and internationally.

• Ability to work closely with engineers and technical specialists when developing customer solutions.

Advantageous experience:

• Previous experience within space, satellites, ISR, SIGINT, electronic warfare, surveillance, secure communications, sensors, UAVs or other advanced defence technologies.

• Previous employment with a defence prime, defence technology company, military organisation, government organisation or procurement authority.

• Experience working with NATO nations or NATO organisations.

• Knowledge of European defence initiatives, funding programmes and procurement mechanisms.

• Military or governmental defence experience.

• Experience working with classified or security-sensitive programmes.

What We Offer

• A full-time role with exposure to a variety of disciplines within space technology.

• A position in an exciting, rapidly growing industry with significant international reach.

• A chance to shape your role and responsibilities within a growing company.

• Great colleagues and several social events each year.

• Health insurance and additional employee benefits.

• Competitive salary and good working conditions.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, apply by submitting your CV and application. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact us via jobs@space-inventor.com, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Interviews are held continuously until the right candidate is found.

Start date to be agreed, but preferably with start-up as soon as possible.

We look forward to receiving your application.

About Space Inventor

Space Inventor is a leading Satellite company with a passion for exploring space and delivering innovative solutions in satellite technology. Our mission is to revolutionize the space industry with creativity, technical expertise, and reliability. With our 250+ years of combined experience in the space industry, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what satellites can achieve.

**Do you want to help develop medical devices that improve patient care and save lives?

**At Ambu, the user is at the center of everything we do. As a Design Validation & Usability Specialist, you will play a key role in bringing the voice of the user into product development through usability engineering, design validation, and user-centered testing.

Working closely with healthcare professionals and cross-functional project teams, you will plan and conduct usability studies, evaluate new product concepts and prototypes, and generate insights that directly influence product design and development.

You will be assigned to projects within specific clinical areas, providing a unique opportunity to build in-depth clinical knowledge and understand the workflows, challenges, and needs of healthcare professionals. You will also gain hands-on experience with simulation manikins and realistic clinical scenarios, enabling you to evaluate products in environments that closely reflect real-world use.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine technology, user understanding, and clinical insight while contributing to the development of innovative medical devices used by healthcare professionals around the world.

**What are we looking for?

**We are looking for a motivated and collaborative professional who thrives in a project-driven environment and enjoys planning, designing, and conducting design validation studies and usability engineering activities.

**As Our Ideal Candidate, You

**

• Have experience within usability engineering, human factors engineering, design validation, user research, or a related discipline, preferably within the medical device industry or another highly regulated environment.

• Have hands-on experience planning, moderating, and conducting usability studies and user evaluations.

• Are able to plan and execute usability engineering and design validation activities using established methods, processes, and templates.

• Have a structured and systematic approach to planning and executing tasks and can manage multiple activities, changing priorities, and project uncertainties while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail.

• Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can identify risks, gaps, uncertainties, and opportunities for improvement.

• Enjoy facilitating workshops and collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand user needs and generate meaningful insights.

• Can communicate findings, recommendations, and concerns clearly to project teams and stakeholders.

• Have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and are comfortable working with international stakeholders and colleagues.

• Have strong technical writing skills and can create clear, structured, and high-quality documentation.

• Work independently within your area of responsibility while knowing when to seek alignment and escalate challenges.

• Take ownership of assigned tasks and consistently deliver high-quality results.

• Are a strong team player who shares knowledge openly, builds positive relationships, and contributes to a supportive team culture.

• Have the maturity and flexibility to navigate changing project priorities and evolving business needs.

• Clinical experience as a healthcare professional (e.g., nurse, physician, or similar) or through direct work in a clinical environment is considered a strong advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Degree in Human Factors, Psychology, Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Medicine, Design, Nursing, or a related field.

• Knowledge of usability engineering and design controls for medical devices, including familiarity with standards and regulations such as IEC 62366-1, ISO 13485, MDR, or FDA guidance.

• Experience planning and conducting usability studies, user needs activities, design validation testing, or risk analysis activities.

• Experience working directly with healthcare professionals and understanding clinical workflows and user needs.

This role would suit someone who enjoys hands-on project work, values collaboration, and wants to further develop their expertise in usability engineering and design validation while contributing to the development of safe and effective medical devices.

**The Team

**You will join our Design Validation & Usability team, a global team of 15 specialists. Our common goal is to ensure the users' voice is integrated throughout product development and that Ambu's solutions are safe, effective, and intuitive for healthcare professionals around the world.

The team is part of Ambu's Clinical Affairs organization and brings together expertise in design validation and usability engineering. We work closely with colleagues across R&D, UX, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Marketing, and Clinical Affairs to ensure that user needs are translated into meaningful and safe product solutions and thoroughly validated throughout the development process.

Our team is distributed across Ambu's headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark, and our Innovation Hub in Augsburg, Germany, creating a collaborative international environment with opportunities to work with colleagues across locations.

Knowledge sharing and collaboration are central to how we work. We actively support one another, exchange experiences, and learn from each other's projects and clinical areas.

The position can be based in either Augsburg, Germany, or Ballerup, Denmark, and reports to the Design Validation & Usability Manager. You should expect regular travel between our Danish and German sites, as well as travel related to user studies and testing activities, primarily in the United States and Great Britain.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.
